result.title: Latent Merger: Latent-Space Composition of Hypernetwork-Generated LoRAs
result.summary: Recent work proposes hypernetworks that convert a document into a low-rank parameter update (LoRA) in a single forward pass, enabling fast injection of new knowledge into a frozen LLM. However, storing separate LoRA adapters for each document can be unsustainable in streaming settings. In this paper, we study the problem of composing hypernetwork-generated LoRAs using two representative systems, Doc-to-LoRA and SHINE. We show that hypernetwork-generated LoRAs have a geometry sharply different from directly fine-tuned LoRAs. They exhibit greater spectral concentration and stronger cross-document alignment than next-token prediction and QA fine-tuned adapters, which are diffuse and nearly orthogonal across documents. Guided by this observation, we propose latent-space LoRA merging. We compose the intermediate hypernetwork latents and then decode the merged latent through the frozen LoRA-generation head. We show that latent-space merging techniques consistently improve over weight-space and factor-space baselines while preserving a single fixed-rank adapter. These results support latent-space composition as a promising mechanism for combining hypernetwork-generated LoRAs under a fixed output-rank budget.

AI.brief_summary: 研究如何组合由超网络生成的文档 LoRA：先分析这类适配器在谱集中度与跨文档对齐上区别于直接微调 LoRA 的几何特性，再提出合并超网络中间 latent 并经冻结的 LoRA 生成头解码，优于权重空间与因子空间基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「合并中间 latent 再解码」的思路与对 latent 几何（谱结构、跨文档对齐）的分析，可能为多个 latent 推理状态或适配器的融合、以及 latent 相似度中内容与结构因素的核查提供方法线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉推理。
